title: Balakrishna
desc: A money-minded local goon is hired to protect a woman from her family's rivals. However, he, initially, only accepts the job for the money but later falls in love with her.

title: Eeswaran
desc: Periyasamy's sons decide to visit him with their families. While Eeswaran, his caretaker, oversees the preparations for this visit, he takes it upon himself to protect the family from danger.

title: Shakthi Thirumagan
desc: After his mother is mercilessly killed, young Kittu is adopted by an elderly man. As he grows older and is left to look after himself, he resolves to find his mother's killer.

title: Cadaver
desc: When two surgeons mysteriously get murdered by Vetri, a prisoner, the responsibility of locating his accomplice falls on the shoulders of a pathologist.

title: Ivan Sariyanavan
desc: Gana, a former army officer, embarks on a mission to eradicate corruption leading him to confront a dangerous politician and his oppressive empire.
Sathya, a young policeman, curses his luck when he gets posted in a control room. However, his life takes an unusual turn after the 100th call he overhears.

title: Whistle Podu
desc: A man tries to fulfil his father's dream of opening a sports academy. However, complications arise when he becomes embroiled in a revenge scheme involving the mafia.

title: Chikku Bukku
desc: Arjun and Anu fall in love with each other on a train journey. When Anu's father learns about their relationship, he remembers that he shares an unpleasant history with Arjun's father.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Thaandavam
desc: Kenny Thomas, a visually challenged man, embarks on a killing spree, committing several murders. However, when the police unravel the crime, Kenny's past is revealed.

title: Manam
desc: Bittu, a six-year-old, loses his parents in an unfortunate car accident. Thirty years later, he comes across two collegians who look exactly like his late parents' young selves.

title: Kaariyavadhi
desc: A shrewd man runs a market to solely reap its profits. Soon, a young man falls in love with his daughter and stands against his authoritative rule.

title: Oh Baby
desc: A seventy-year-old woman frustrated with her life, blames God for her misfortune. Subsequently, she magically transforms into a twenty-four-year-old after getting her photo taken at a studio.

title: Pon Manickavel
desc: Pon Manickavel, IPS officer, is given the task to solve the case of a judge's murder. While his team attempts to crack the crime, the lives of high-profile persons are threatened.

title: Maari 2
desc: Maariyappan, a gangster, is confronted by Gangadhar Beeja, a rival. While he strives to defeat him, he attempts to cope with his son's questionable behaviour.

title: Sangathalaivan
desc: A humble textile worker meets a staunch Communist after a tragic incident. Subsequently, he joins the movement after enduring exploitation, sparking a fight for workers' rights.
